claim_scope: Independent external retrospective research evidence only; no clinical validation, device approval, diagnosis, or autonomous-use claim
eligibility_rules: Use only the exact acquired release named by the manifest; do not mix versions or mirrors.
Input must be a regular non-reparse-point color fundus image within the model byte and pixel limits.
Image bytes must decode successfully and retain their input SHA-256.
A primary-endpoint case must have compatible BRSET DR_ICDR ground truth and a valid patient_id for cluster accounting.
Preserve exam_eye exactly as supplied; do not infer laterality.
A case may be executed only after modality, quality, OOD, provenance, and model-identity gates pass.
All non-executed cases remain in the coverage denominator accounting with an explicit reason.
predeclared_exclusion_rules: UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: non-fundus or unsupported file type
DECODE_FAILURE: image cannot be decoded or fails channel/shape limits
MISSING_REQUIRED_ARTIFACT: image or required ground truth is absent
QUALITY_BLOCKED: existing quality gate rejects the image; the gate is not relaxed
OOD_BLOCKED: existing domain gate rejects the image; the gate is not changed
MODEL_FAILURE: inference fails; it is never recorded as a negative result
LABEL_AMBIGUITY: source label mapping is not defensible
PATIENT_GROUPING_UNUSABLE: patient_id is absent or inconsistent for a required cluster analysis

ground_truth_mapping.referable_reference_definition: DR_ICDR >= 2; research reference condition only, not a diagnosis or referral decision
ground_truth_mapping.other_labels: Do not substitute binary pathology fields for DR_ICDR or silently merge SDRG with ICDR.

quality_rules.gate: Use the existing application quality gate unchanged
quality_rules.accounting: QUALITY_BLOCKED cases remain visible and are not recoded as negatives

ood_rules.gate: Use the existing application OOD/domain gate unchanged
ood_rules.camera_metadata: Report as a subgroup when available; do not turn an unvalidated camera into an in-domain claim
ood_rules.accounting: OOD_BLOCKED cases remain visible in coverage accounting

missing_data_rules: Never infer patient, eye, laterality, camera, site, age, sex, race, or ethnicity from pixels.
Missing patient_id blocks patient-clustered claims and is not imputed.
Missing exam_eye is retained as laterality unknown and is not filled from filename ordering.
Missing DR_ICDR blocks the corresponding ground-truth endpoint and remains counted as missing ground truth.
Unavailable quality/OOD metadata is reported as unknown, not as pass.

frozen_lesion_rule.model_output: Candidate lesion regions from the installed research lesion model only
frozen_lesion_rule.interpretation: Review-escalation signal only; not clinical sensitivity, disease recovery, or diagnostic accuracy

frozen_models.runtime: dedicated isolated Python runtime; CPU bounded threads
dedicated isolated Python runtime; CPU bounded threads

primary_endpoint.name: REVIEW_ESCALATION_COVERAGE
primary_endpoint.unit: eligible executed images, with patient-cluster sensitivity analysis
primary_endpoint.definition: Among executed cases with DR_ICDR >= 2, count cases for which LESION_ESCALATION_RULE_PHASE7_V1 is true.
primary_endpoint.numerator: referable/high-grade reference AND frozen lesion rule escalates
primary_endpoint.miss_definition: referable/high-grade reference AND frozen lesion rule does not escalate
primary_endpoint.language_boundary: Do not label this sensitivity, specificity, diagnosis, or disease recovery.

secondary_endpoints.name: REVIEW_ESCALATION_BURDEN
secondary_endpoints.definition: Among executed DR_ICDR < 2 cases, count cases for which the frozen lesion rule escalates.
secondary_endpoints.reporting: escalated lower-risk cases per 100 eligible lower-risk executed cases

secondary_endpoints.name: DR_RESEARCH_MODEL_PERFORMANCE
secondary_endpoints.definition: Evaluate the unchanged DR research output against DR_ICDR only if execution and labels are valid.

secondary_endpoints.name: GRADE_3_AND_GRADE_4_REVIEW_ESCALATION
secondary_endpoints.definition: Report support, DR research output, lesion escalation, un-escalated count, and reason separately for ICDR 3 and ICDR 4.

coverage_accounting.unavailable_denominator_policy: Use null with NOT_MEASURED status when the dataset is not acquired; never use zero to mean unavailable.

patient_eye_grouping.policy: Do not merge eyes; report patient-clustered intervals where a patient contributes more than one eye/image.
patient_eye_grouping.cluster_method: patient-cluster bootstrap or cluster-robust proportion interval, predeclared before inference
patient_eye_grouping.laterality_policy: OD/OS values are preserved; unknown remains unknown

subgroups.demographic: Age/sex may be described only from trusted source metadata and only with governance approval; race/ethnicity are not inferred.
subgroups.minimum_reporting: N, execution coverage, review-escalation coverage, review burden, and insufficient-sample flags
subgroups.tiny_groups: INSUFFICIENT_SUBGROUP_SAMPLE; no fairness or device-validation claim

statistics.continuous_model_scores: AUROC/AUPRC only as research ranking metrics; raw score is not a calibrated probability
statistics.p_value_policy: No p-value fishing; no multiplicity-driven selective reporting
statistics.calibration: No calibration on the external evaluation set; any calibration requires a separate calibration cohort

reproducibility.selector: Sort valid input SHA-256 values lexicographically and select the first min(100, all eligible) cases; selection is fixed before inference.
reproducibility.rerun: Repeat the same deterministic subset with the same artifact, preprocessing, runtime, and protocol hashes.
reproducibility.mismatch_definition: Any changed execution status, grade, lesion region count, escalation state, or failure code is a mismatch.

stopping_rules: STOP before inference if rights are not defensible for the requested research scope.
STOP before inference if the exact dataset release cannot be obtained and hashed.
STOP before inference if training overlap cannot be excluded enough for the claim.
STOP before inference if patient/eye grouping is unusable for the claimed endpoint.
STOP before inference if ground-truth semantics do not match the endpoint.
STOP before inference if manifest or protocol integrity fails.
If stopped, classify EXTERNAL REVIEW ESCALATION VALIDATION NOT ESTABLISHED and GENERALIZATION NOT MEASURABLE.
forbidden_changes: No external-threshold, region-count, area, class-filter, or camera-specific tuning
No dropping quality/OOD/model failures after seeing outcomes

preinference_decision.reason: BRSET access requires credentialing, CITI training, and a signed DUA; no authorized access or files were present.

hash.scope: canonical JSON with the hash property omitted
